title: Make product search case-insensitive
body:
## Problem
Searching for `Helmet` finds Ridge Helmet and Metro Helmet. Searching for `HELMET` or `helmet` finds nothing. This is the intentional Chapter 2 defect, not a production incident.

## Reproduce
1. Run `npm ci` and `npm run dev`.
2. Search for `Helmet`, then `HELMET`.
3. Run `npm run test:exercise` to see the failing acceptance check.

## Expected behavior
Product-name searches ignore letter case. Leading and trailing whitespace remains ignored.

## Acceptance checks
- `Helmet`, `HELMET`, `helmet`, and `HeLmEt` find the same two helmets.
- ` Helmet ` still finds the two helmets.
- Empty search still returns the complete catalog.
- Unknown names still return no products.
- Existing sorting and stock filtering still work.

## Scope
Change `server/catalog.ts` and its regression tests. Keep partial name matching. Do not add dependencies, category filtering, fuzzy matching, authentication, or a database.

## Verification
Run `npm run check`, `npm run test:exercise`, and `npm run test:e2e` (after installing Chromium). Add permanent regression coverage in `tests/catalog.test.ts`. Keep the exercise check intact.

Leave this issue unassigned until a reader deliberately starts the exercise.

title: Filter products by category
body:
## Outcome
A visitor can browse Protection, Accessories, or Bags without knowing a product name. The current app displays categories but has no category filter.

## Proposed acceptance checks
- All categories is the initial selection.
- Selecting a category shows only matching products.
- Category selection combines with search, stock filtering, and sorting.
- The result count reflects the visible products.
- Resetting filters restores all categories.
- The control works with keyboard input and on mobile.

## Questions to settle before implementation
Should selecting a category persist in the URL? Should a category with no matching results remain selectable? Record the answers in this description. Do not invent a release date.

## Non-goals
Do not add checkout, accounts, category administration, or a new data store. Do not combine the independent search defect with this feature.

## Starting context
Use `docs/chapter-02/meeting-transcript.md` to practice drafting and reviewing requirements. Product categories are in `server/catalog.ts`; the UI is in `src/catalog.ts`.

This is planning work, not an instruction to start implementation.
